name: app_explore
description: Explore the system and the application before anything changes. Load for the explore stage of a run pipeline.

history.why: taxteller (Nextflow, mammoth): the census listed no language and 0 entry points because .nf files were unknown. Add Nextflow: .nf counts as language "nextflow", nextflow.config as build file, a .nf with an unnamed `workflow {` block is an entry point (main.nf), and explore_validate accepts nextflow (annotated through shell-step wrappers).
